property_summary: For any admissible input, once an owner transfers an NFT via transferFrom, the previous owner can no longer approve spenders for that token (approve reverts with NOT_AUTHORIZED since _ownerOf moved); the mutant never updates _ownerOf, so the old owner still approves, violating the rule.
change_summary: Remove the ownership assignment `_ownerOf[id] = to;` so the token's owner never changes after transferFrom.
